products.name: Cells
products.description: Read, edit, convert and render workbooks through the Aspose.Cells object model.

commands.description: Convert a workbook, or CSV or TSV text, to another format with the engine's options for it. An html, mhtml or md output is one file: it holds its images itself (SaveAsSingleFile, ExportImagesAsBase64).
Create a workbook: the engine's new workbook, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.
Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a workbook; nothing is written when one fails.
Read a workbook's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.
Render sheets, or an area of one, to images as the engine draws them.
Search the text of a workbook's cells, as their number formats show it, their formulas and their comments; each hit names the object's address and row.

products.name: PDF
products.description: PDF automation with page, security and fixed-layout semantics.

commands.description: Convert selected PDF pages to a supported format.
Create a PDF from exactly one source family.
Apply one validated, atomic PDF operation batch.
Extract bounded PDF assets, text, tables or form data.
Show PDF structure, security state and properties.
Merge PDF inputs in order.
Read a bounded page-text window.
Render one or more PDF pages.
Search PDF text and return page rectangles.
Apply a PKCS#7 signature and verify the saved signature field.
Split a PDF into an atomic output set.
Validate a PDF against a PDF/A profile.

products.name: Slides
products.description: Read, edit, convert and render presentations through the Aspose.Slides object model.

commands.description: Convert a presentation or selected slides.
Create a presentation: the engine's new presentation, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.
Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a presentation; nothing is written when one fails.
Extract the media a presentation embeds, byte for byte.
Read a presentation's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.
Render one or more slides for visual verification.
Search the text of a presentation's shapes, table cells, notes and chart titles; each hit names the object's address.

products.name: Words
products.description: Read, edit, convert and render documents through the Aspose.Words object model.

commands.description: Compare a changed document with the original, Document.Compare, and write the redline: a copy of the original whose revisions are the differences.
Convert a document to another format with the engine's options for it. An html, html-fixed or md output is one file: it holds its images, fonts and styles itself.
Create a document: the engine's new document, or a copy of a template saved in the output's format.
Apply a batch of set, add, delete, move and do operations to a document; nothing is written when one fails.
Write the bytes of each image the document stores, ImageData.ImageBytes, one file per image in document order; a linked image stores none.
Read a document's objects, each with every row of the object table, and its inventory.
Render one or more document pages.
Search the text of a document's paragraphs, as Paragraph.GetText() gives it; each hit names the paragraph's address.
